name: Device Model
description: BMS / Inverter Model Name ASCII string
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.1

name: Serial Number
description: BMS Serial Number string
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.1

name: Firmware Version
description: Master BMS Software/Firmware Version
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.1

name: BMS Running Status
description: 0: Offline, 1: Standby, 2: Running, 3: Fault, 4: Sleep
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2 (ESS)

name: Battery Working Mode
description: 0: None, 1: Forced charge/discharge, 2: Time of use, 3: Fixed charge/discharge, 4: Maximise self-consumption
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Battery Bus Voltage
description: Total DC Bus Voltage of Battery System
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Battery Bus Current
description: Battery Bus Current (positive: discharge, negative: charge)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Charge/Discharge Power
description: Instantaneous Battery Power (positive: discharge, negative: charge)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Max Charge Power Limit
description: System hardware maximum permitted charge power
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Max Discharge Power Limit
description: System hardware maximum permitted discharge power
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: State of Charge (SOC)
description: Overall battery state of charge percentage (0.0% to 100.0%)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: State of Health (SOH)
description: Overall battery state of health percentage
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Total Cumulative Charge Energy
description: Cumulative electrical energy charged into battery
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Total Cumulative Discharge Energy
description: Cumulative electrical energy discharged from battery
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Battery Temperature
description: BMS system internal temperature measurement
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Online Battery Modules Count
description: Number of connected online battery modules
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.2

name: Module 1 Running Status
description: Battery pack module 1 operating status
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Bus Voltage
description: Module 1 terminal bus voltage
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Bus Current
description: Module 1 current
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Max Cell Voltage
description: Highest measured cell voltage in Module 1 (1 mV resolution)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Min Cell Voltage
description: Lowest measured cell voltage in Module 1 (1 mV resolution)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Max Cell Temperature
description: Highest measured cell temperature in Module 1
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Min Cell Temperature
description: Lowest measured cell temperature in Module 1
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Module 1 Alarm Mask 1
description: Active alarm bitmask for Module 1 (lower words)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 5.3

name: Grid Max Charge Power Setting
description: Operator adjustable maximum charge power from grid
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 6.1 (Settings)
verification_procedure: Read back holding register 47081 and verify match

name: Grid Max Discharge Power Setting
description: Operator adjustable maximum discharge power to grid
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 6.1 (Settings)
verification_procedure: Read back holding register 47083 and verify match

name: End-of-Discharge SOC Cutoff
description: Battery lower cutoff state of charge (stops discharge)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 6.1 (Settings)
verification_procedure: Read back holding register 47085 and verify match

name: End-of-Charge SOC Cutoff
description: Battery upper cutoff state of charge (stops charging)
source_doc: Huawei Modbus Interface Definitions V3.0 Sec 6.1 (Settings)
verification_procedure: Read back holding register 47086 and verify match
